findings.where: front face, left and right of the central latch
findings.evidence: Two extra iron brackets with barrel knuckles, like hinges, sit on the front face, so the chest shows four hinge-like pieces plus the latch where the spec calls for two back hinges and one front latch.
The hinge plates lie on the sloped lid top and don't clearly connect to a matching leaf on the chest body, so their pivot placement is ambiguous.
